content: {"phoneNote":"The hero stacks a four-line headline, paragraph, licence-plate CTA and a 'Navodila za pot' link that repeats the one already in the header, pushing hours and address below the fold.","desktopNote":"The hero headline swallows the whole first screen over a vineyard/castle landscape that says nothing about tyres, and 'Navodila za pot' appears three times within the first two screens.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":2,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Replace the generic landscape hero photo with a workshop/tyre image (or a flat dark panel) and shrink the desktop headline so hours and address enter the first screen.","Remove the duplicate 'Navodila za pot' links in the hero and info band; keep the header one and the fixed phone bar as the only route action.","Reduce the oversized section titles (KAJ DELAMO, CENE STORITEV, footer VULKANIZERSTVO ZORMAN) and tighten vertical padding so the page reads as one rhythm."],"blockers":["Desktop footer: 'VULKANIZERSTVO ZORMAN' title is set so large it nearly spans the full width and is clearly oversized versus the content around it."]}
